headline: Profit grows on resilient demand and strong bookings
summary_short: DLF's September-2026 quarter net profit was ₹1,301 crore (+11% y/y per TaxGuru; other outlets say +10%) on consolidated revenue of ₹2,298 crore and ₹3,800 crore of bookings.
summary_long: Per secondary coverage, EBITDA was ₹1,060 crore and gross margin 47%. Operating cash flow was ₹1,858 crore, a ₹1,980 crore dividend was paid out and net cash stood at ₹15,084 crore. Outlets disagree on revenue and EBITDA definitions, and the filing itself was not read, so figures are indicative.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Figures here come from a news write-up (TaxGuru) found by web search because no exchange filing or company release was reachable; press coverage conflicts on growth (10% vs 11%) and on revenue and EBITDA definitions. Treat as unverified against the BSE/NSE filing.
